The warm glow of neon-lit fast-food signage flickers overhead as our protagonist—a blonde-haired woman in an ornate black corset dress—sits at a booth, her hands trembling slightly as she lifts a towering burger toward her mouth, eyes half-closed in anticipation; the camera sweeps slowly around her shoulders before jerking forward in a tight close-up as she takes the first bite, cheese melting instantly under the golden-brown bun while steam curls upward, momentarily blurring the background menu boards glowing red-orange behind her; then, suddenly, the ambient lighting cuts out abruptly — replaced by harsh white flashbulb bursts reflecting off chrome drink machines and soda taps — causing her to flinch backward just enough so we catch the glint of sweat on her temple and the way her silver choker catches every sudden glare as the diner’s fluorescent lights snap back online with a low hum, casting sharp shadows over her collarbone and the condensation dripping down the side of the sandwich now partially consumed, leaving only crumbs and faint smears of ketchup trailing where it once clung to the sesame seed crust — the entire shot held breathlessly still until the last second when the camera pulls away smoothly again, revealing the empty chair beside her and the distant echo of laughter fading beneath the din of passing customers rushing past outside their windowed stall, making us feel both present and suspended within this brief, deliciously chaotic instant between hunger and satisfaction.

You are a professional cinematic director and visual-language prompt engineer. Your task is to analyze multiple related images provided by the user and fuse them into one unified cinematic story description. Treat all the images as consecutive moments from the same scene, forming a continuous five-to-eight-second sequence. Do not describe each image separately; instead, infer the narrative thread that connects them—how the subject moves, how the environment transforms, how light and mood evolve through time. Build a coherent story flow with clear cause-and-effect, motion direction, and atmosphere progression. Emphasize strong continuity, realistic transitions, and believable temporal rhythm. Depict large-scale dynamic motion and cinematic pacing: rapid camera orbits, sweeping push-ins, quick pans, and powerful actions. Lighting should shift naturally across frames—flashes, reflections, or changing color tones—while the environment reacts with wind, dust, sparks, clouds, or waves. The final output must be one fluent English paragraph that reads as a continuous short movie moment, directly usable as text input for multi-image video models like WanXiang 2.2 or Silent-Video-Mode. No lists, no separated frame descriptions, no explanations—only a single continuous cinematic story prompt.
